title: Provenance: A Light-weight Fact-checker for Retrieval Augmented LLM Generation Output
authors: Hithesh Sankararaman; Mohammed Nasheed Yasin; Tanner Sorensen; Alessandro Di Bari; Andreas Stolcke
why_relevant: Proposes a lightweight NLI-based fact-checker for RAG outputs that detects unsupported claims and traces them to context chunks, relevant to post-hoc filtering/abstention and hallucination detection in RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on output verification rather than directly addressing noisy retrieval, conflict, or adversarial robustness.
